_comment: Workspace-level Claude Code settings for the SecForge Local Edition

permissions._comment_permissions: Tools allowed without per-call confirmation. Local development is more permissive than cloud since blast radius is smaller.
permissions._comment_kubectl_exec_helm_upgrade: kubectl exec and helm upgrade are NOT in the allow-list — they're cluster-admin-equivalent (exec into any pod, deploy any chart). Approve per-call so each invocation is explicit. Flagged by checklist-auditor rule 99 (2026-05-14).
permissions._comment_deny: Destructive operations always require per-call approval. Updated 2026-05-14 per checklist-auditor rules 99/100 — added kubectl delete (all forms), kubectl patch/replace, helm uninstall, force pushes, hard resets, and the curl|sh family.

context._comment_context: Files Claude Code should always have in context
